== Description ==

[[Ryan Jellison]] (left, grey “SUMMER LEAGUE” sweatshirt, glasses, short grey-brown hair), [[Joe Olson]] (right foreground, reddish beard, glasses, grey tee, holding a hand of cards), and [[Bryan Mischke]] (mid, light grey hoodie, backwards black cap, looking down) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
